proof: Frozen worker calls HDS with 候補収集=True and preserves the HDS answer/status/reasons (except a valid candidate pair can supply a valid first answer).
The family loop skips a family if NOT 採用可 OR NOT 同値採用. Both flags are required; a fitted candidate without equality admission can be skipped.

A family passing both flags and returning None appends a family-specific undefined-query reason. A valid grid is appended to prediction candidates before HDS query; an invalid non-None value either yields a valid HDS answer or appends a family-specific HDS hold reason.

Nonempty predictions produce a valid first answer or the explicit complete-grid conflict reason; nonempty unresolved reasons with no predictions produce family-specific reasons. Initial fast-path answers are valid grids and cannot create these primary fallback rows.

All 249 saved fallback rows have only generic base-HDS observation/quarantine reasons. All 110 possible family-specific hold labels and the conflict label survive wrapper sanitization (maximum 34 characters; none matches the filtered long-hex pattern). Thus the admitted-family loop did not process any family for these rows.
